OriGen worked with Ecopetrol to conduct historical production matching on a complex reservoir consisting of thousands of wells and 40 years of historical data dating back to the ‘80s.
By running thousands of simulations that factored data alongside geological plausibility, OriGen successfully created a model that matched 85 percent of the wells in the oilfield of study.
